# Workflow: code style guides

- Names
    - variable names should be lowercase, have numbers, and `_`
    - long, descriptive names are generally better than concise names that are fast to type
- Spaces
    - spaces on either side of mathemetical operators apart from `^` and around the assignment operator (`<-`)
    - don't put spaces inside or outside parentheses for regular function calls
    - put a space after a comma, not before
    - you can add extra spaces to improve alignment
- Pipes
    - `|>` should always have a space before it and should typically be the last thing on a line
    - put each argument on a new line
    - if the function doesn't have named arguments, keep everything on one line unelss it doesn't fit
    - indent each line by two spaces
- ggplot2
    - treat `+` the same way as `|>`
- Sectioning comments
    - as scripts get longer, you can use sectioning comments to break up file into manageable pieces

```
# Load data --------------------------------------
```
